dedupe_keys.name: city scale high resolution traffic datasets with refined networks for hierarchical traffic control

description: City-scale high-resolution traffic datasets with refined networks for hierarchical traffic control is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Qinzhou Ma et al. Urban-scale traffic control faces significant challenges due to the limited availability of large-scale and high-resolution datasets to support traffic control strategies across various network topologies and scales. To address this limitation, we present traffic datasets for benchmarking traffic control strategies, possibly with hierarchical architectures. The datasets include five cities of varying scales with diverse intersection layouts and network topologies. Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. Formats: JSON, Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 5874371075 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
